# Al Nabooda Showroom Fujairah

> This automotive facility stands on Sheikh Maktoum Bin Rashid Al Maktoum Road in the Haleefath district of Fujairah, on the UAE's east coast. It pairs single-storey car showrooms with a multi-brand service centre holding thirteen workshop bays, a wheel alignment facility and an integrated quick-repair body shop. Opened in December 2013, it serves Audi and Volkswagen owners across Fujairah and the northern emirates.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Haleefat, Fujairah, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2013

## MENASCO Scope

This automotive facility in Fujairah combines a car showroom with a service workshop for Al Nabooda Automobiles, the Dubai-based dealer group with showrooms across Dubai, Sharjah and Fujairah. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the showroom and workshop for Al Nabooda Automobiles, with Arif & Bintoak as consultant.
